tools.name: calculate_bmi
tools.description: Compute Body Mass Index and its weight classification from height and weight alone. Adults use the WHO cutoffs (underweight / normal / overweight / obese); for ages 2–19 pass age + sex and it uses the CDC BMI-for-age percentiles instead. Returns a canonical myplate.food URL and source citation.

height_cm.description: Height in centimeters (or use height_ft + height_in).

age.description: Age in years (2–120). Omit for standard adult BMI; required (with sex) for ages 2–19 youth percentiles. Under 2 there is no BMI reference; weight status is assessed on weight-for-length.

sex.description: Required only when age < 20 (CDC curves are sex-specific).

tools.name: calculate_body_fat
tools.description: Estimate body-fat % using the U.S. Navy circumference method, with a Deurenberg BMI-based cross-check and ACE category. Needs sex, age, height, weight and tape measurements of neck and waist (plus hip for women).

age.description: Age in years (18–80). The Deurenberg cross-check and the ACE bands are adult references; the Navy equation itself does not use age.

height_cm.description: Height in centimeters (or use height_ft + height_in).

hip_cm.description: Hip circumference in cm; required for women (or hip_in).

tools.name: calculate_body_metric
tools.description:
Run one of myplate.food's quick body-composition & fitness calculators and get its value plus the healthy band. Pick `metric` and pass that metric's fields:
• waist-to-height: waist, height
• waist-to-hip: waist, hip, sex
• lean-body-mass: weight, height, sex
• ffmi: weight, height, body_fat, sex
• water-intake: weight (+ optional activity: sedentary|moderate|active)
• weight-loss-percentage: start_weight, current_weight
• one-rep-max: weight, reps
Lengths and weights follow `unit` (metric = cm/kg, imperial = in/lb; default metric).

tools.name: calculate_myplate_plan
tools.description: Estimate daily calorie needs (IOM Estimated Energy Requirement) and return the USDA MyPlate food-group plan at that level: cups of fruit/vegetables/dairy, ounce-equivalents of grains/protein, plus weekly vegetable & protein subgroup targets and BMI. From age, sex, height, weight and activity (pregnancy/lactation optional).

sex.description: Biological sex, used in the energy equation.

activity.description: Physical activity level. Defaults to sedentary.

height_cm.description: Height in centimeters (or use height_ft + height_in).

pregnancy.description: Pregnancy status (adds the IOM trimester calorie allowance).

lactation.description: Lactation status (adds the IOM lactation calorie allowance).

edition.description: DRI Estimated Energy Requirement equation set. Defaults to iom2005.

tools.name: calculate_calorie_needs
tools.description: Use this when you want the whole energy picture in one call. Returns resting metabolic rate (Mifflin-St Jeor) and revised Harris-Benedict, total daily energy expenditure (TDEE) at every activity level, up to three weight-loss deficit tiers, macronutrient splits, protein targets and healthy-weight ranges. This is a superset of calculate_tdee, calculate_calorie_deficit, calculate_macros, calculate_protein_target, calculate_bmr and calculate_ideal_weight; use those only when you need a single number. Same profile inputs as the MyPlate plan. weight_loss_targets lists only the paces myplate.food itself offers: a pace whose target is under 1,200 kcal a day for women or 1,500 for men (the low end of the calorie prescriptions in the 2013 AHA/ACC/TOS obesity guideline) is left out and named, without a figure, in weight_loss_not_offered. weight_loss_default is the pace the calculator page opens on and weight_loss_floor_kcal is the floor that was applied. In pregnancy and while breastfeeding no targets are returned, and weight_loss_withheld gives the reason (pregnancy or lactation). Above the healthy-BMI band, ideal_weight also carries firstGoal (the weights 5 to 10% under the current weight, the first goal in the 2013 AHA/ACC/TOS obesity guideline) and adjusted (the Hamwi ideal weight plus 25% of the weight above it). Both are null at or under the band, and in pregnancy and while breastfeeding. Do not work out a lower target yourself when one is left out or withheld. Adult equations: ages 18 to 120. A younger age returns 400; for a child or teenager use myplate-plan or dri, whose energy equations have child forms.

age.description: Age in years (18–120). These are adult equations; for a child or teenager use calculate_myplate_plan or calculate_dri.

sex.description: Biological sex, used in the energy equation.

activity.description: Physical activity level. Defaults to sedentary.

height_cm.description: Height in centimeters (or use height_ft + height_in).

pregnancy.description: Pregnancy status. Weight-loss figures are withheld during pregnancy, and the protein RDA follows it.

lactation.description: Breastfeeding status. Weight-loss figures are withheld while breastfeeding, and the protein RDA follows it.

tools.name: calculate_bmr
tools.description: Compute basal/resting metabolic rate: the calories your body burns at rest. Returns the headline Mifflin-St Jeor (1990) value plus the revised Harris-Benedict (Roza & Shizgal 1984) estimate for comparison. Needs age, sex, height and weight. Adult equations: ages 18 to 120. A younger age returns 400; for a child or teenager use myplate-plan or dri, whose energy equations have child forms.

age.description: Age in years (18–120). These are adult equations; for a child or teenager use calculate_myplate_plan or calculate_dri.

sex.description: Biological sex, used in the energy equation.

height_cm.description: Height in centimeters (or use height_ft + height_in).

tools.name: calculate_tdee
tools.description: Use this when you need maintenance calories: the total daily energy expenditure. Mifflin-St Jeor resting metabolic rate scaled by a physical-activity multiplier; returns the TDEE at the given activity level plus a table across all four levels (sedentary → very-active). Needs age, sex, height, weight and activity. For deficits, macros and protein alongside it, use calculate_calorie_needs instead. Adult equations: ages 18 to 120. A younger age returns 400; for a child or teenager use myplate-plan or dri, whose energy equations have child forms.

age.description: Age in years (18–120). These are adult equations; for a child or teenager use calculate_myplate_plan or calculate_dri.

sex.description: Biological sex, used in the energy equation.

activity.description: Physical activity level. Defaults to sedentary.

height_cm.description: Height in centimeters (or use height_ft + height_in).

tools.name: calculate_calorie_deficit
tools.description: Use this when someone wants a weight-loss calorie target. Returns maintenance calories (TDEE) and up to three deficit tiers: mild (−250), standard (−500) and aggressive (−750 kcal/day), each with the realistic weekly rate it buys, and a flag when a target dips below BMR. Needs age, sex, height, weight and activity; pass pregnancy or lactation when either applies. weight_loss_targets lists only the paces myplate.food itself offers: a pace whose target is under 1,200 kcal a day for women or 1,500 for men (the low end of the calorie prescriptions in the 2013 AHA/ACC/TOS obesity guideline) is left out and named, without a figure, in weight_loss_not_offered. weight_loss_default is the pace the calculator page opens on and weight_loss_floor_kcal is the floor that was applied. In pregnancy and while breastfeeding no targets are returned, and weight_loss_withheld gives the reason (pregnancy or lactation). Do not work out a lower target yourself when one is left out or withheld. Adult equations: ages 18 to 120. A younger age returns 400; for a child or teenager use myplate-plan or dri, whose energy equations have child forms.

age.description: Age in years (18–120). These are adult equations; for a child or teenager use calculate_myplate_plan or calculate_dri.

sex.description: Biological sex, used in the energy equation.

activity.description: Physical activity level. Defaults to sedentary.

height_cm.description: Height in centimeters (or use height_ft + height_in).

pregnancy.description: Pregnancy status. Weight-loss figures are withheld during pregnancy.

lactation.description: Breastfeeding status. Weight-loss figures are withheld while breastfeeding.

tools.name: calculate_macros
tools.description: Split a daily calorie budget into protein, carbohydrate and fat grams across three presets. Balanced (20/50/30) sits inside the IOM acceptable macronutrient distribution ranges (protein 10 to 35%, carbohydrate 45 to 65%, fat 20 to 35%); higher-protein (30/40/30) and lower-carb (30/35/35) put carbohydrate below its range. Each preset in the response carries withinAmdr. Pass `calories` directly, or a body profile (age, sex, height, weight, activity) to derive TDEE first. With a profile: Adult equations: ages 18 to 120. A younger age returns 400; for a child or teenager use myplate-plan or dri, whose energy equations have child forms.

calories.description: Daily calorie budget to split. Omit to derive TDEE from a profile.

age.description: Age in years, 18 or over (if deriving from a profile).

sex.description: Biological sex (if deriving from a profile).

activity.description: Physical activity level. Defaults to sedentary.

height_cm.description: Height in centimeters (or use height_ft + height_in).

tools.name: calculate_protein_target
tools.description: Daily protein target in grams from body weight and activity level: the IOM RDA for the life stage (0.8 g/kg for adults; 0.85 at 14 to 18, 1.1 in the second half of pregnancy, 1.3 while breastfeeding) and an activity-scaled range up to the Academy of Nutrition and Dietetics / Dietitians of Canada / ACSM (2016) 1.2 to 2.0 g/kg athlete range. Needs age, sex, height, weight and activity; pass pregnancy or lactation when either applies. Under 18 the answer is the RDA alone: range is null, byActivity is empty and activity_range_withheld is "under_18", because the activity ranges are adult sports-nutrition guidance.

sex.description: Biological sex, used in the energy equation.

activity.description: Physical activity level. Defaults to sedentary.

height_cm.description: Height in centimeters (or use height_ft + height_in).

pregnancy.description: Pregnancy status. The protein RDA follows it.

lactation.description: Breastfeeding status. The protein RDA follows it.

tools.name: calculate_ideal_weight
tools.description: Estimate ideal body weight from height and sex via four classic clinical formulas (Devine 1974, Robinson 1983, Miller 1983, Hamwi 1964), plus the healthy-BMI (18.5–24.9) weight band and current BMI for context. Needs age, sex, height, weight. Adult equations: ages 18 to 120. A younger age returns 400; for a child or teenager use myplate-plan or dri, whose energy equations have child forms. Above the healthy-BMI band, ideal_weight also carries firstGoal (the weights 5 to 10% under the current weight, the first goal in the 2013 AHA/ACC/TOS obesity guideline) and adjusted (the Hamwi ideal weight plus 25% of the weight above it). Both are null at or under the band, and in pregnancy and while breastfeeding. weight_loss_withheld gives the reason when they are withheld.

age.description: Age in years (18–120). These are adult equations; for a child or teenager use calculate_myplate_plan or calculate_dri.

sex.description: Biological sex, used in the energy equation.

height_cm.description: Height in centimeters (or use height_ft + height_in).

pregnancy.description: Pregnancy status. Weight-loss figures are withheld during pregnancy.

lactation.description: Breastfeeding status. Weight-loss figures are withheld while breastfeeding.

tools.name: calculate_glp1_protein
tools.description: Protein target to preserve muscle during weight loss on a GLP-1 medication (Ozempic, Wegovy, Zepbound, Mounjaro): the 1.2 to 1.6 g/kg preservation range vs the IOM protein RDA for the age (0.8 g/kg for adults, 0.85 at 14 to 18, higher below 14), the per-meal amount over 4 meals, and the DRI fiber Adequate Intake for age and sex. When the range runs above 120 g/day it also returns the fixed 80 to 120 g/day option from the 2025 GLP-1 nutrition advisory, with its note that actual body weight can overestimate needs. With height it also returns the 2026 EASO/EFAD/ECPO consensus range: 1.0 to 1.5 g/kg of adjusted body weight, at least 60 g/day. Needs weight, age and sex; height is optional.

unit.description: Units for weight and height. Default metric (kg, cm).

sex.description: Biological sex (sets the fiber Adequate Intake).

weight.description: Body weight (kg or lb per unit).

height.description: Height (cm or in per unit). Adds the 2026 European consensus range from adjusted body weight.

tools.name: calculate_dach_energy
tools.description: Daily energy requirement for the German/Austrian DGE/ÖGE framework: resting energy via the Müller et al. (2004) equation the DGE uses, scaled by a PAL activity factor. Returns resting energy, the requirement at the chosen PAL, and a table at PAL 1.4 / 1.6 / 1.8. Needs sex, age and weight. Adults only: the DGE derives this equation for adults and publishes table reference values for children and adolescents instead.

age.description: Age in years (19–120). Adults only: the DGE derives this equation for adults and publishes table reference values for children and adolescents instead.

pal.description: Physical Activity Level factor (default 1.6, DGE range 1.2–2.4).

tools.name: calculate_dri
tools.description: Return the full Dietary Reference Intakes table for a life stage: recommended intakes and tolerable upper limits for macronutrients, vitamins and minerals (IOM 2005/2006/2011, NASEM 2019), plus the Estimated Energy Requirement and BMI. Needs age, sex, height, weight (pregnancy/lactation optional; edition iom2005 | nasem2023).

sex.description: Biological sex, used in the energy equation.

activity.description: Physical activity level. Defaults to sedentary.

height_cm.description: Height in centimeters (or use height_ft + height_in).

pregnancy.description: Pregnancy status (adds the IOM trimester calorie allowance).

lactation.description: Lactation status (adds the IOM lactation calorie allowance).

edition.description: DRI Estimated Energy Requirement equation set. Defaults to iom2005.

tools.name: search_recipes
tools.description: Search the ~1,072-recipe USDA MyPlate Kitchen collection (public domain). Filter by free-text query, ingredients on hand, food group, dish category, max calories and minimum rating. Returns recipe cards with slug, calories, food groups, image and links. Use get_recipe with a slug for the full recipe.

q.description: Free-text search over recipe name + description, e.g. "black bean".

ingredients.description: Comma-separated ingredients on hand, up to 20, e.g. "chicken, rice, broccoli". Returns recipes using at least one, those using the most first, each with matched_ingredients.

food_group.description: Food-group key: fruits, vegetables, grains, protein-foods, or dairy.

max_calories.description: Only recipes at or below this calorie count per serving.

tools.name: get_recipe
tools.description: Fetch one recipe by its slug: ingredients, directions, full USDA nutrition table, MyPlate food-group amounts, serving size, yield, rating, image and source attribution. Get slugs from search_recipes.
